title: Parallel Tool Calls over a DAG
hints: Spawn one wrapper task per node you start. Inside it, `yield loop.spawn(run_tool(node_id))` (or `yield from run_tool(node_id)`) inside a try/except ToolError.
When a wrapper finishes, update the node's status, free its slot, and immediately start whatever is ready now, in sorted id order, until the slots are full.
A failure cancels the node's transitive descendants and nothing else. Independent branches keep running.
Don't wait for a whole level of the DAG to finish before starting the next. A node becomes ready the moment its own deps are done.
